title: feat(nm2t2slz): M two-tick composition on two-axis same-lock z-probes: reverse fails, face fails, composition HOLD
science: Two-axis same-lock seed, z-probes, M two-tick composition: M(t)=M(t+1) at all four probes, composition HOLD, exist-opposite fail/fail at both cuts. Its own steelman concedes the composition HOLD is 'an accident of frozen singletons'. Also reports that on this cell timed-O gives reverse=hold face=fail while M gives reverse=fail face=hold - the two duals give opposite verdict pairs.
